answer: Bandwidth-Weighted Message Propagation Tax. Every agent identity must attach a cryptographic marble to broadcast transactions. This token carries a forwarding fee scaling exponentially with local network congestion. When multiple identities cluster on the same routing node, the falcon algorithm detects high correlation and multiplies their collective transmission costs. An attacker spawning fake nodes pays an escalating financial penalty for every correlated signal sent through shared infrastructure, making mass sybil expansion economically unviable.
